title: reading/entries-export/v1
description: The bytes of a reading list's file, as the file holds them.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

Bytes.description: Bytes, such as a file's contents: text when they are valid UTF-8, and base64 otherwise.

text.description: The bytes, which are valid UTF-8, as text.

base64.description: The bytes, which are not valid UTF-8, in standard base64 with padding (RFC 4648).
